name: race_offline_outcome_same_tick_lives
description: A race whose crews clear wave 12 on the same tick is decided by the lives they lost (design 1.3: the race time is the clear tick plus 10 s a life lost, the lower wins), and its rule says so (review of M6's race views: Game.race_rule_line() took a same-tick finish for 'You cleared wave 12 first'). Over the session's offline race, a Tide Race of two seats each waits out its windows; both hollows clear wave 12 on the same tick, the rival with two lives lost, so my race time is 20 s the lower. SimMatch decides it on time for my team, and the results say 'You Outran the Tide' with the rule 'Fewer lives lost: your race time is the lower', not that my crew cleared first.

steps.msg: both hollows cleared wave 12 on the same tick
the rival's two lost lives add 20 s to its race time
the simulation decides it on time, for my team

steps.assert: node('ResultsTitle').text == 'YOU OUTRAN THE TIDE' and node('ResultsRule').text == 'Fewer lives lost: your race time is the lower'
steps.msg: the rule that decided it is the lives, not who cleared first
